# datadog_integration_github_costs_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog GitHub Costs integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the GitHub Costs integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the GitHub Costs integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the GitHub Costs integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from GitHub Costs, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `git_hub_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--git_hub_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--git_hub_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.git_hub_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) For an enterprise, a personal access token (classic) from an Enterprise Admin user with the `manage_billing:enterprise` and `read:org` scopes. For an organization, a fine-grained personal access token owned by that organization and created by an organization owner, with the `Administration` organization permission set to read-only. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) For an enterprise, a personal access token (classic) from an Enterprise Admin user with the `manage_billing:enterprise` and `read:org` scopes. For an organization, a fine-grained personal access token owned by that organization and created by an organization owner, with the `Administration` organization permission set to read-only. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `enterprise_name` (String) Slug of the GitHub enterprise, as in `https://github.com/enterprises/<enterprise-name>`, or login of a GitHub organization, as in `https://github.com/<organization-name>`.

Optional:

- `tags` (String) Comma-separated list of custom tags for this GitHub Costs account.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Read-Only:

- `github_cloud_cost_metrics` (Attributes) GitHub costs, including Actions, storage, and Copilot, which you can analyze in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). Reported costs are estimates based on list prices and usage data and include discounts when available, but not negotiated rates. Requires Cloud Cost Management on your Datadog organization and a GitHub account on the enhanced billing platform. Without them, this dataflow collects no data. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, so it appears in responses only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--github_cloud_cost_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--github_cloud_cost_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.github_cloud_cost_metrics`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Always `true`, because this collection cannot be turned off.
- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--github_cloud_cost_metrics--status))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--github_cloud_cost_metrics--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.github_cloud_cost_metrics.status`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Collection health of a single dataflow.
- `message` (String) Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.
